verdict.rationale: Tailscale ships an official CLI, Docker support, and infrastructure-as-code/webhook automation for tailnets, and a community example shows it being run headlessly inside GitHub Actions as an exit node. However, there's no first-party CI-specific guide (e.g. a dedicated GitHub Action or auth-key headless walkthrough) in the evidence. Missing for 10: official CI/CD integration docs (e.g. GitHub Action), explicit headless auth-key setup guide, and independent hands-on confirmation beyond one anecdote.
